levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than five reviews are checked, or warning signs are applied inconsistently.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least five reviews are checked against all three warning signs, and the most suspicious review is correctly identified.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner explains a combination of warning signs rather than just one.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The learner does not confirm avoiding unfamiliar links or personal information entry.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner confirms no unfamiliar links were clicked and no personal information was entered.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner explains what a genuine review pattern looks like compared to the suspicious one.

lookFors: The task was completed only on a household-approved device.
No personal information was entered anywhere online during this task.

A learner who completed the simulation/equal-credit alternative instead of the real-world version should be scored on this same rubric using the alternative submission as the evidence — using the sanctioned alternative is not itself a reason to score lower.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
